the growth of esophageal cancer is regulated by EGF and IGH-1 receptors and autocrine factors.

the growth of human esophageal cancer cells may be regulated by autocrine stimulation of EGF and/or IGF-I receptors.
the overexpression and autocrine regulation of EGF and/or IGF-I receptor in esophageal carcinoma may be a potential target for the development of novel anticancer drugs.
